segments.ja521:2.3: Rajjaṃ kāretukāmena, kiṃ su kiccaṃ kataṃ varaṃ”.
segments.ja521:3.3: Pamatto appamattaṃ maṃ, pitā puttaṃ acodayi.
segments.ja521:4.3: Tato kiccāni kāreyya, taṃ vataṃ āhu khattiya.
segments.ja521:5.1: “Yaṃ tvaṃ tāta tapokammaṃ [tape kammaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], pubbe katamasaṃsayaṃ;
segments.ja521:5.3: Ratto duṭṭho ca yaṃ kayirā, na taṃ kayirā tato puna [punaṃ (pī.)].
segments.ja521:6.3: Sabbe bhogā vinassanti, rañño taṃ vuccate aghaṃ.
segments.ja521:7.1: “Sirī tāta alakkhī ca [sirī ca tāta lakkhī ca (syā. pī.)], pucchitā etadabravuṃ;
segments.ja521:9.1: “So tvaṃ sabbesu suhadayo [so tvaṃ sabbesaṃ suhadayo (syā. pī.), so tvaṃ sabbe suhadayo (ka.)], sabbesaṃ rakkhito bhava;
segments.ja521:9.3: Alakkhiṃ nuda mahārāja, lakkhyā bhava nivesanaṃ.
segments.ja521:11.3: Sa kalyāṇe dhitiṃ katvā, uṭṭhāne kurute mano.
segments.ja521:13.3: Vāyamassu ca kiccesu, nālaso vindate sukhaṃ.
segments.ja521:14.3: Alaṃ mitte sukhāpetuṃ, amittānaṃ dukhāya [dukkhāya (pī.)] ca”.
segments.ja521:15.1: “Sakkhisi tvaṃ [sakkhī tuvaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] kuṇḍalini, maññasi khattabandhuni [khattiyabandhunī (pī.)];
segments.ja521:15.3: Rajjaṃ kāretukāmena, kiṃ su kiccaṃ kataṃ varaṃ”.
segments.ja521:16.3: Aladdhassa ca yo lābho, laddhassa cānurakkhaṇā.
segments.ja521:18.1: “Yo ca taṃ tāta rakkheyya, dhanaṃ yañceva te siyā;
segments.ja521:18.3: Sūtova rathaṃ saṅgaṇhe, so te kiccāni kāraye.
segments.ja521:20.1: “Sayaṃ āyaṃ vayaṃ [āyavayaṃ (pī.)] jaññā, sayaṃ jaññā katākataṃ;
segments.ja521:21.3: Mā te adhammikā yuttā, dhanaṃ raṭṭhañca nāsayuṃ.
segments.ja521:22.1: “Mā ca vegena kiccāni, karosi [kāresi (sī. syā. pī.)] kārayesi vā;
segments.ja521:22.3: Vegasā hi kataṃ kammaṃ, mando pacchānutappati.
segments.ja521:23.3: Kodhasā hi bahū phītā, kulā akulataṃ gatā.
segments.ja521:24.3: Itthīnaṃ purisānañca, mā te āsi dukhudrayo.
segments.ja521:25.3: Sabbe bhogā vinassanti, rañño taṃ vuccate aghaṃ.
segments.ja521:27.1: “Apucchimha kosiyagottaṃ [apucchimhā kosiyagottaṃ (syā.), apucchamhāpi kosikaṃ (pī.)], kuṇḍaliniṃ tatheva ca;
segments.ja521:27.3: Tvaṃ dāni vadehi jambuka [jambuka tvaṃ dāni vadehi (syā. pī.)], balānaṃ balamuttamaṃ”.
segments.ja521:28.3: Tattha bāhubalaṃ nāma, carimaṃ vuccate balaṃ.
segments.ja521:31.1: “Taṃ balānaṃ balaṃ seṭṭhaṃ, aggaṃ paññābaṃ balaṃ [varaṃ (sī.)];
segments.ja521:32.3: Akāmassa pasayhaṃ vā, añño taṃ paṭipajjati.
segments.ja521:33.3: Duppañño hi kāsipati, sabbenapi na jīvati.
segments.ja521:34.1: “Paññāva sutaṃ vinicchinī [paññā sutavinicchinī (syā. pī.)], paññā kitti silokavaḍḍhanī [vaddhanī (pī.)];
segments.ja521:34.3: Paññāsahito naro idha, api dukkhe sukhāni vindati.
segments.ja521:36.1: “Yo ca dhammavibhaṅgaññū [yo dhammañca vibhāgaññū (pī.)], kāluṭṭhāyī matandito;
segments.ja521:36.3: Anuṭṭhahati kālena, kammaphalaṃ tassa ijjhati [kammaphalaṃ tassijjhati, phalaṃ tassa samijjhati (ka.)].
segments.ja521:39.3: Tāni tvaṃ tāta sevassu, mā akammāya randhayi;
segments.ja521:40.3: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
segments.ja521:41.3: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
segments.ja521:42.3: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
segments.ja521:43.3: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
segments.ja521:44.1: “Dhammaṃ cara mahārāja, gāmesu nigamesu ca … pe ….
segments.ja521:45.1: “Dhammaṃ cara mahārāja, raṭṭhesu [raṭṭhe (pī.)] janapadesu ca … pe ….
segments.ja521:46.1: “Dhammaṃ cara mahārāja, samaṇa [samaṇe (syā. ka.)] brāhmaṇesu ca … pe ….
segments.ja521:47.3: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
segments.ja521:48.1: “Dhammaṃ cara mahārāja, dhammo ciṇṇo sukhāvaho [dhammo suciṇṇo sukhamāvahati (ka.)];
segments.ja521:48.3: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
segments.ja521:49.1: “Dhammaṃ cara mahārāja, saindā [indo (pī.), sindā (ka.)] devā sabrahmakā;
segments.ja521:49.3: Suciṇṇena divaṃ pattā, mā dhammaṃ rāja pāmado [pamādo (pī. ka.)].
segments.ja521:50.3: Sappaññasevī kalyāṇī, samattaṃ sāma [sāmaṃ (ka.)] taṃ vidū”ti.
